title: DAMO-YOLO-T 3-class (person/phone/hand) fine-tune, 60 epochs, stock loader
hypothesis: A 3-class DAMO-YOLO-T fine-tuned on OI adds a usable hand class (AP50>=0.60) without losing person AP50 by more than 2 points and with phone precision at recall 0.70 >= the decode-fixed pretrained model
baseline: pretrained DAMO-YOLO-T COCO, float ONNX, reference decoder (m5.t.reference@native_val)
primary_metric: hand AP50; person AP50; phone precision at recall 0.70 (Open Images protocol, research/detector_bench)
success_criteria: false-phone rate on phone-free images <= pretrained
budget: one oryn run, <= 21,600 s job timeout, --vram-mb 4500

dataset.name: oi7-sd-v1
dataset.licence: Open Images V7: annotations CC BY 4.0, images CC BY 2.0 (per file)

model.base: DAMO-YOLO-T 41.8 COCO (tinynasL20_T_418, Apache-2.0, authors' Drive mirror)

config.loader: stock load_pretrain_detector: whole ZeroHead (gfl_cls, gfl_reg, scales) re-initialised

seed: 1234 recorded in the config but NOT applied: the stock DAMO-YOLO trainer has set_seed commented out (damo/apis/detector_trainer.py:98, found in M8.4), so the run is unseeded
hardware: oryn RTX 4060 8 GB (WSL), torch from the sdgpu env
decision_note: fails person preservation; kept only as a research checkpoint and as the EXP-09 comparator. Never promoted.
preregistration_note: criteria committed in 90ce5a5 (docs/research/EXP08_RESULTS.md) before the job started

title: Head-preserving fine-tune: keep pretrained gfl_reg/scales, seed person/phone class rows from COCO
hypothesis: EXP-08's person regression is caused by load_pretrain_detector re-initialising the class-agnostic box regressor (gfl_reg, scales) and the class head; starting from the pretrained regressor and the COCO person/phone class rows recovers person recall at precision 0.80 to within 0.01 of the pretrained model while keeping the phone and hand gains
baseline: pretrained DAMO-YOLO-T reference decoder (person R@P0.8 0.661, M8.1 job 20261112-152527-afe36f) and EXP-08 at NMS 0.5 (preds sha16 ba6b0ad1b8952867)
primary_metric: person recall at precision 0.80 (Open Images protocol, research.m8.analysis paired, photographer-group bootstrap, 1000 resamples)
success_criteria: person R@P0.8: paired delta (pretrained - EXP-09) point estimate <= 0.010 (95% CI reported)
secondary, reported not gating (M7): person P@R0.70 >= 0.66; person AP50 >= 0.703; phone R@P0.8 >= 0.75; false-phone images <= pretrained
mechanism_check: if the hypothesis holds, person and phone AP50:95 and mean true-positive IoU move back toward the pretrained values (person 0.544 / 0.871, phone 0.707 / 0.943); reported whatever the gate says
budget: ONE oryn run: job timeout 12,600 s (3.5 h), training budget 11,900 s, --vram-mb 4500 --cpus 6 --mem 8G; skipped if GPU util > 30% from other users

dataset.name: oi7-sd-v1
dataset.licence: Open Images V7: annotations CC BY 4.0, images CC BY 2.0 (per file)

model.base: DAMO-YOLO-T 41.8 COCO (tinynasL20_T_418, Apache-2.0, authors' Drive mirror)
model.init: gfl_reg + scales copied; gfl_cls rows person<-0, phone<-67, hand fresh (DAMO init)

config.trained_parameters: all (single-variable change vs EXP-08: head initialisation; the seed is now applied)
config.nms_for_scoring: DAMO postprocess 0.7, then re-suppressed at 0.5 (as EXP-08, M7)

software_revision: recorded in the job's state.json at submit
leakage_control: research/m84/leakage_check.py on the manifest before training and on the trainer's COCO export after; local manifest copy: 0 shared ids, 0 shared photographer groups, 0 shared file sha256 across train/val/test
preregistration_note: criteria committed in a23ce19 before submission

title: Detector characterisation: size/occlusion/truncation, luminance proxy, error anatomy, look-alikes, train hard negatives
hypothesis: descriptive: locate where person/phone/hand detection fails on OI val (no gate)
baseline: pretrained reference / legacy decoders; EXP-08 NMS 0.5
primary_metric: recall at precision 0.80 by attribute; AP50 by luminance quartile (group CI); FP categories
decision_note: kept as the characterisation baseline; informs the experiment ranking
preregistration_note: descriptive analysis recorded after the run

title: Host-simulated INT8 (ONNX Runtime QDQ) of the shipping DAMO-T heads graph - NOT Hailo
hypothesis: 8-bit post-training quantisation of the shipping heads graph changes person/phone AP50 by less than 0.015 (the M8 INT8 acceptance gate), and the uint8 outputs alone change nothing
baseline: the same float heads graph (reproduces M5: 0.656/0.728 legacy, 0.713/0.795 reference)
primary_metric: paired delta AP50 and R@P0.80, float - variant (group bootstrap, 300)
success_criteria: delta AP50 <= 0.015 per class (borrowed from the M8 L3/L4 gate; L2 only informs it)
decision_note: hypothesis rejected for person at L2 (delta 0.032 > 0.015, CI excludes it); says naive PTQ is not enough; L3/L4 must decide
preregistration_note: hypothesis written after the run; not a pre-registered test
